notes: Sabotrack controls: Space does everything nearby (tasks, the emergency button, fixing lights, holding the meltdown consoles, portals, hiding and coming out), E kills, R reports, and the big Use button shows what Space will do. Saboteurs get a bigger minimap: tap ⚡, ☢️ or any gate on it and it happens straight away, so you can sabotage while you walk (up to 3 gates, then a cooldown). A lights sabotage flips the Electrical lever down to red; anyone (saboteurs too) fixes it with a quick fuse swap. Outside the game, Space uses whatever you're standing at.
